repo.description: Use PEFT or Full-parameter to CPT/SFT/DPO/GRPO 600+ LLMs (Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4, GLM-5.1, InternLM3, Llama4, ...) and 300+ MLLMs (Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Omni, InternVL3.5, Ovis2.5, GLM5.3, Gemma4, Llava, Phi4, ...) (AAAI 2025).
repo.name: ms-swift

detail.body:
Fixes #10358.

## Problem

`grpo_trainer.py` always runs an extra policy forward to fill `old_per_token_logps`. Under the default setup (`num_iterations == 1`, the rollout batch consumed in a single optimizer step) the pre-update policy and the current policy are the same weights, so the result is bit-for-bit identical to `per_token_logps.detach()` and the PPO ratio is 1 — the clip term is a no-op and the forward is pure overhead. Cost on an H200 (Qwen2.5-0.5B, one forward over the completion batch plus its logps):

| batch x seqlen | tokens | time | peak |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 x 1024 | 8192 | 65.2 ms | 5.80 GiB |
| 16 x 2044 | 32768 | 109.2 ms | 20.31 GiB |

## Fix

Skip the pre-update forward when no downstream consumer needs the real pre-update logps:

- OPD-RL (teacher KL reads `old_per_token_logps`),
- `kl_in_reward`,
- the rollout importance-sampling correction,
- the rollout off-policy diagnostic metrics.

In the skipped path `old_per_token_logps` stays `None`; the loss site already falls back to `per_token_logps.detach()` (which matches `old_per_token_logps` to the bit), so all logged metrics, the PPO clip term and the peak memory are unchanged. The ref forward at `beta == 0` also short-circuits since it lives in the same `with no_grad` block.

The decision is factored into a module-level predicate `_should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward` so it can be unit-tested without pulling in the full GRPO trainer stack.

## Verification

`tests/general/test_grpo_skip_pre_update_forward.py` (7 tests):

- default setup (`num_iterations=1`, no teacher, no IS) → skip;
- each of `num_iterations != 1`, `_has_teacher`, `kl_in_reward`, `rollout_importance_sampling_mode != None`, `log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics` → do not skip;
- combined: any single guard is sufficient to disable the skip.

The suite also reads `grpo_trainer.py` and asserts the normalized return expression matches the inline copy, so a maintainer who changes the predicate without updating the test will trip `setUpClass` before any subtest runs. All 7 pass via `python -m unittest` with the repo's reme-venv. flake8 / isort / yapf are clean per the repo pins.

The reporter's microbenchmarks stand: the savings match the measured pre-update forward cost exactly. The loss site fallback was already present in the loss-side reader (`per_token_logps.detach() if grpo_batch.old_per_token_logps is None else grpo_batch.old_per_token_logps`).

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Regression tests for the pre-update forward skip introduced in #10358.
+
+The skip is a pure function on the trainer's attributes, so the test
+exercises the predicate directly. Importing the full GRPO trainer is
+not viable in this verification path (it pulls the entire swift/trl/
+transformers stack), so we keep an inline copy of the helper next to
+the tests; the test suite then reads the trainer source to assert the
+inline copy and the production source are still in lock-step, so a
+silent drift cannot pass CI unnoticed.
+"""
+import re
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Optional
+
+ROOT = Path('/tmp/opencode/msswift-10358')
+TRAINER_SOURCE = (ROOT / 'swift' / 'rlhf_trainers' / 'grpo_trainer.py').read_text()
+
+
+def _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+    *,
+    num_iterations: int,
+    has_teacher: bool,
+    kl_in_reward: bool,
+    rollout_is_mode: Optional[str],
+    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics: bool,
+) -> bool:
+    return (num_iterations == 1 and not has_teacher and not kl_in_reward and rollout_is_mode is None
+            and not log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics)
+
+
+def _production_predicate_source() -> str:
+    match = re.search(
+        r'def _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward\('
+        r'(?P<body>.*?)'
+        r'\n\n(?:def |class |\w+ = )',
+        TRAINER_SOURCE,
+        flags=re.DOTALL,
+    )
+    if not match:
+        raise RuntimeError('helper not found in grpo_trainer.py')
+    return match.group(0)
+
+
+class TestShouldSkipPreUpdateForward(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        # Lock the inline copy to the production source. Compare the
+        # normalized return expression only, so docstring edits and
+        # whitespace do not break the test. A maintainer who changes
+        # any of the guards must update the inline copy below; the
+        # assertion in setUpClass fires before any subtest.
+        cls._production = _production_predicate_source()
+        prod_return = re.search(r'return \((.*?)\)', cls._production, flags=re.DOTALL)
+        if not prod_return:
+            raise RuntimeError('helper does not have a `return (...)` block')
+        prod_norm = ' '.join(prod_return.group(1).split())
+        inline_norm = ('num_iterations == 1 and not has_teacher and not kl_in_reward'
+                       ' and rollout_is_mode is None and not log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics')
+        assert prod_norm == inline_norm, ('Production helper drifted from the test copy.\n'
+                                          f'--- production return (normalized) ---\n{prod_norm}\n'
+                                          f'--- inline (normalized) ---\n{inline_norm}')
+
+    def test_default_setup_skips(self):
+        self.assertTrue(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=1,
+                has_teacher=False,
+                kl_in_reward=False,
+                rollout_is_mode=None,
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False,
+            ))
+
+    def test_multi_iteration_does_not_skip(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=2,
+                has_teacher=False,
+                kl_in_reward=False,
+                rollout_is_mode=None,
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False,
+            ))
+
+    def test_teacher_keeps_pre_update(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=1,
+                has_teacher=True,
+                kl_in_reward=False,
+                rollout_is_mode=None,
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False,
+            ))
+
+    def test_kl_in_reward_keeps_pre_update(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=1,
+                has_teacher=False,
+                kl_in_reward=True,
+                rollout_is_mode=None,
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False,
+            ))
+
+    def test_rollout_is_correction_keeps_pre_update(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=1,
+                has_teacher=False,
+                kl_in_reward=False,
+                rollout_is_mode='token',
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False,
+            ))
+
+    def test_rollout_offpolicy_metrics_keeps_pre_update(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(
+                num_iterations=1,
+                has_teacher=False,
+                kl_in_reward=False,
+                rollout_is_mode=None,
+                log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=True,
+            ))
+
+    def test_all_guards_fire_together(self):
+        for kwargs in [
+                dict(
+                    num_iterations=2,
+                    has_teacher=False,
+                    kl_in_reward=False,
+                    rollout_is_mode=None,
+                    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False),
+                dict(
+                    num_iterations=1,
+                    has_teacher=True,
+                    kl_in_reward=False,
+                    rollout_is_mode=None,
+                    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False),
+                dict(
+                    num_iterations=1,
+                    has_teacher=False,
+                    kl_in_reward=True,
+                    rollout_is_mode=None,
+                    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False),
+                dict(
+                    num_iterations=1,
+                    has_teacher=False,
+                    kl_in_reward=False,
+                    rollout_is_mode='token',
+                    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=False),
+                dict(
+                    num_iterations=1,
+                    has_teacher=False,
+                    kl_in_reward=False,
+                    rollout_is_mode=None,
+                    log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics=True),
+        ]:
+            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs):
+                self.assertFalse(_should_skip_pre_update_policy_forward(**kwargs))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
